title: TopologyOverlaySignalTargetCoverage
description: Compact target coverage summary for a scoped topology overlay signal. This intentionally omits graph target ids.

eligibleTargetCount.description: Number of topology targets in this artifact that are eligible for this signal before source/value matching.

matchedTargetCount.description: Number of topology targets expected to receive values or effects for this signal in the current scope.

truncated.description: Whether counts were truncated or capped while building the scoped context.
